text_status_meanings.author_manuscript: the author's own version, as sent to the outlet
text_status_meanings.publisher_excerpt: only the outlet's free teaser; the original is paywalled
text_status_meanings.link_only: audio or video; no text is stored, the record links to the source
text_status_meanings.machine_transcript: audio or video; the text is a machine transcript of it, checked against the recording and lightly tidied into standard Czech (fillers and false starts removed; numbers, negations and hedges unchanged), so it is still speech
text_status_meanings.publisher_transcript: audio or video; the text is the transcript the broadcaster itself published, with the speakers as it named them
text_status_meanings.correspondence: a letter or memo the author sent — to a public body, to colleagues, to students — never published anywhere. The date is the day it was sent, and is exact
text_status_meanings.unpublished_manuscript: written for the outlet and submitted, but never printed; the date is the issue it was written for, not a publication date

provenance_meanings.editorial: an outlet's editor stood between the author and the reader
provenance_meanings.self_published: posted by the author, with no outlet editing it
provenance_meanings.unpublished: never printed anywhere, so no editor and no publication date
provenance_meanings.correspondence: sent to named recipients rather than published; no editor stood between the author and the reader
provenance_meanings.archive_translation: a translation (English from Czech, or Czech from English) made with AI for this archive and published by it; the original and its own provenance are linked from the record
provenance_meanings.institutional_record: written inside an institution as an internal document and released later by that institution as a record of its own proceedings; no outlet editor stood between the author and the reader, and the publication date is the institution's release, not the writing
